pr_title: [ML] Increase wait for forecasts in FIPS JVM
pr_body:
Forecast tests have been seen to fail in the FIPS JVM
because they take far longer than without FIPS.

This change waits up to 5 minutes for forecasts in FIPS
mode (compared to the usual 1 minute).

Fixes #63793

comments:
Another one with 7.x: https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/gpojhbkhxysfs
Not reproducible locally.

The failures are [all from the fips jobs](https://build-stats.elastic.co/app/kibana#/discover?_g=(refreshInterval:(pause:!t,value:0),time:(from:now-30d,mode:quick,to:now))&_a=(columns:!(build.job-name),index:b646ed00-7efc-11e8-bf69-63c8ef516157,interval:auto,query:(language:lucene,query:testOverflowToDisk),sort:!(process.time-start,desc))). Not sure if that means something or just coincidence.

> The failures are [all from the fips jobs](https://build-stats.elastic.co/app/kibana#/discover?_g=(refreshInterval:(pause:!t,value:0),time:(from:now-30d,mode:quick,to:now))&_a=(columns:!(build.job-name),index:b646ed00-7efc-11e8-bf69-63c8ef516157,interval:auto,query:(language:lucene,query:testOverflowToDisk),sort:!(process.time-start,desc))). Not sure if that means something or just coincidence.

I think it probably means that the test runs a bit slower in fips jobs than non-fips.  Looking at the relevant bit of the server side log for the first failure, the forecast took 32 seconds:

```
[2020-10-16T07:42:07,989][INFO ][o.e.x.m.p.l.CppLogMessageHandler] [integTest-1] [forecast-it-test-overflow-to-disk] [autodetect/354739] [CForecastRunner.cc@124] Start forecasting from 2020-10-16T05:00:00+0000 to 2020-10-16T06:00:00+0000
[2020-10-16T07:42:39,587][INFO ][o.e.x.m.p.l.CppLogMessageHandler] [integTest-1] [forecast-it-test-overflow-to-disk] [autodetect/354739] [CForecastRunner.cc@217] Finished forecasting, wrote 8000 records
```

But the test requires that it completes in 30 seconds: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/51d0bcacdf0c2daf47ae1f17574e1884304a8271/x-pack/plugin/ml/qa/native-multi-node-tests/src/javaRestTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ml/integration/MlNativeAutodetectIntegTestCase.java#L302

[2020-10-30T03:43:54,843][INFO ][o.e.x.m.p.l.CppLogMessageHandler] [javaRestTest-1] [forecast-it-test-overflow-to-disk] [autodetect/472440] [CCmdSkeleton.cc@51] Handled 120000 records

I will bump the timeout to 60 seconds.
I just stumbled upon this same failure today: https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/ekxjxyoy7r4tc/console-log?task=:x-pack:plugin:ml:qa:native-multi-node-tests:javaRestTest .

> I just stumbled upon this same failure today

It's happening in the FIPS JVM, like in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/58806#issuecomment-762931901.

I will alter the test to wait _much_ longer for the forecast to complete in the FIPS JVM.

review_comments: Why is the default here (`30`) different than it is above (`60`)?

The wait was 30 everywhere prior to #64471 (which relates to the same test failure in the forecast overflow to disk tests).  It was increased to 60 in that PR, but the only place a higher value was ever required was when waiting for a forecast to finish, not for waits on other statuses.  So now there is the opportunity to have a different length of wait for finish I put the length of wait for other statuses back to the original level.
